name: The Slice of Life of Armpit-Chan
source:
The boy wakes up feeling terrible only to realize he has a talking face on his armpit. The reader will guide this guy to make the choice in the process of getting rid of it while developing relationship with his armpit. Way to start off a new day!

[From [url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/the-slice-of-life-of-armpit-chan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
男孩醒来时感觉很糟糕，却发现自己的腋下有一张会说话的脸。读者将在与腋窝建立关系的同时，引导这个家伙在摆脱它的过程中做出选择。就这样开始新的一天吧！

[来自[url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/the-slice-of-life-of-armpit-chan]Itch.io[/url]]
